thread:
luis_acme (customer): Hey team, after this morning's prod rollout our assistant started dropping earlier instructions in long threads. It used to keep the system prompt + first 2 user messages, now it ignores them and repeats earlier steps incorrectly. Example below.

maya (support): Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste a minimal convo + the request_id or trace id? Also which model & deployment?

luis_acme (customer): request_id=cr-2024-11-23-88a1, model=redwood-medium-v3, deployment=hosted-us-east. Sample: 
User1: "You are an assistant that always asks clarifying q's before answering."
User2: "Summarize the thread and extract action items."
Assistant: (starts summarizing but misses the clarifying-q requirement and cuts the summary after 2 bullets).

maya (support): thanks. Can you confirm prompt token length & that you're sending full convo in the messages array (not truncated client-side)?

luis_acme (customer): tokens~4800, we send the full history in messages[]. We didn't change client code. This regressed right after your 06:12 deploy.

deploy-bot: rollout finished: hosted-us-east v2024.11.23-6 at 06:12 UTC (canary->global)

maya (support): tagging eng: @joel @rachel — customer sees instructions from the start of the thread being ignored and mid-thread truncation. Attach logs?

joel (eng-ml): pulling logs for cr-2024-11-23-88a1. Can you paste the exact request payload (sanitized) and the assistant output? Also which response_mode (streaming vs non-streaming)?

luis_acme (customer): sending payload now (sanitized):
```
{
  "model": "redwood-medium-v3",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You always ask clarifying questions."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Summarize the thread..."},
    ... ~20 messages ...
  ],
  "max_tokens": 8000,
  "response_mode": "non-streaming"
}
```
Assistant output (truncated): "Summary: - Item A - Item B" (no clarifying q requirement, stops mid-list)

joel (eng-ml): partial logs show KV cache hits then an eviction event at token_idx=1024 for that session id. That's odd — eviction threshold should be based on total seq length, not absolute position.

rachel (eng-runtime): note we rolled a new kernel selection change in v2024.11.23-6 that tweaks attention window packing for cost perf. Could be a regression in prefix retention logic for multi-turn sessions.

maya (support): customer says this is high severity — affects production assistant. Requesting immediate rollback or mitigation.

joel (eng-ml): can we repro locally? I'll run the same payload against canary pinned to old kernel and new kernel.

rachel (eng-runtime): doing a quick config check — autoscaler and batching configs unchanged. But the runtime did flip a default kv_eviction_margin param from 0.1 -> 0.05 in the rollout (intended to reduce memory overhead). If margin too small, early cache eviction could drop prefix frames.

luis_acme (customer): any chance to hotfix? We have SLAs and this breaks user-facing behavior.

maya (support): escalated to oncall, including rollback as a mitigation option. Joel/Rachel please confirm repro or hotfix window.

joel (eng-ml): repro steps I'm running: curl to hosted endpoint with request_id header, attach conversation file, compare outputs. If I can reproduce, I'll open a hotfix PR to restore kv_eviction_margin.

rachel (eng-runtime): I can push a temporary config override for the affected pool to restore previous margin — need approval from infra leads. Meanwhile canary->global rollback is on the table.

deploy-bot: incident created: INC-2024-4558 - "context retention regression after kernel rollout" (severity: P1)

maya (support): thanks. I'll notify the customer and ask for any additional failing examples. @luis_acme (customer) — if you can capture a streaming session id next time, that helps trace KV behavior too.

luis_acme (customer): will do. Also noticed latency spikes ~200ms higher after rollout — maybe related.

joel (eng-ml): noted. I'll include latency and memory metrics in the investigation. If we confirm a kernel regression, rollback ASAP.

rachel (eng-runtime): quick update — I applied a temporary config override to the us-east pool restoring kv_eviction_margin to previous value. Early tests from Joel show prefix retention fixed for his repro.

maya (support): I informed the customer about the mitigation and asked them to validate in 10m.

luis_acme (customer): validated — instructions are back, coherence restored. Thanks for the quick turnaround. Please keep me posted on permanent fix.

joel (eng-ml): next steps: open revert PR for the kernel param tweak, add unit tests for prefix retention under long-history sessions, and add a regression test in canary to detect this.

rachel (eng-runtime): also adding a metric alert for unexpected KV eviction counts per session so future rollouts trigger earlier.

maya (support): closing loop with customer, will update incident with timeline & postmortem once available. Thanks all for the fast response :thumbsup:
